Vanessa —

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed their logs from last week and have a few technical notes:
- Root cause appears to be KV-cache eviction that coincides with large nightly batches; that increases token load and trips our autoscale threshold.
- Short-term mitigation: raise cache retention for AcuLytics model shards and enable throttled batching for their batch window. We can do this with config flags, should be safe for 2–3 weeks while we test a tighter kernel placement.
- Longer-term: recommend a dedicated pool with a slightly different kernel/quantization profile — reduces peaks by ~25% in our sim.

I'm attaching an updated tab to the risk register with the engineering mitigation timeline (see "aculytics-risk-register-20270418.xlsx" - tab: eng-mitigations).

I'll need Marcus to estimate cost delta for a 6-week dedicated slot. If we go that route, operations will need a 48-hour runway to provision and validate.
